newsitem.title: USA: Styling buys ABBA products for $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Styling buys ABBA products for $20 mln.

text.p: Styling Technology Corp said it bought the issued and outstanding capital stock of U.K.-based ABBA Products Inc for $20 million and expects the deal to be accretive to earnings and will result in a significant increase in revenues.
ABBA had revenues of about $10.5 million during the fiscal year ended Dec. 31 and revenues of approximately $3.2 million for the three months ended March 31.
ABBA is the producer of a proprietary line of aromatherapy-based professional hair-care products.

In connection with the acquisition of ABBA, Styling Technology entered into a six-year, $28 million credit facility with Credit Agricole Indosuez. Styling Technology utilized $23 million to finance the purchase price and related costs and to repay existing indebtedness.
The credit facility also includes a revolving line of credit of $5 million for working capital purposes.

ABBA, established in 1988, has enjoyed rapid growth in recent years in the popular aromatherapy category of the beauty industry. ABBA markets its 100 percent vegan products (with no animal ingredients whatsoever) under the trademark ABBA Pure & Natural Hair Care.
